title: elaphoglossum wawrae
intro: Elaphoglossum wawrae, commonly known as the Wawra's Elaphoglossum, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in the Pacific Islands, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce fever and soothe skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Elaphoglossum wawrae include its ability to act as an antiseptic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory agent, while its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic compounds, are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties. However, further research is needed to confirm the effectiveness and safety of using Elaphoglossum wawrae for medicinal purposes.
